Expected

Actual

Expected the submission to be refused, but it was accepted: the form is gone; no field is marked invalid; no error message is shown; confirmation: "Thank you. We received it. Reference VAL-0122." (now at http://127.0.0.1:4370/validation/done?ref=VAL-0122).

Where to look

The application accepted a value it should refuse for "age" (technique: min-1). The page declares the rule, so the browser would stop a normal user — but the server does not enforce it, and anything that skips the page's checks gets through. Add the same validation to the server-side handler and return an error tied to "age". (A starting point drawn from what the test observed, not a diagnosis of the code.)
